newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - New York Bagel cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - New York Bagel cut.

text.p: -- Rauscher Piece Refsnes Inc analyst Lynne Collier on Monday cut her rating on New York Bagel Enterprises Inc to buy-market outperformer from buy-focus.
-- She also trimmed her 1997 earnings outlook to $0.30 a share from $0.50.

-- Earlier, New York Bagel said it expects fourth quarter earnings of between $0.04 and $0.05 a share, compared with pro-forma year-ago results of $0.02. Collier said her estimate for the fourth quarter had been $0.08 a share.
-- New York Bagel shares at mid-day were down 2-1/4 at 4-1/2.

-- "The earnings shortfall was mostly the result of cost issues ... which occurred late in the quarter, and less-than-expected revenues as the timing of new store openings (primarily franchise) fell short of our projections," Collier said.
-- The analyst added that shortfall in earnings, compared with her projection, pertains to controllable issues rather than a deterioration in the underlying business.

-- "Same-store sales during the quarter were up nearly five percent -- reflecting a very healthy base of stores in what we believe to be a very attractive sub-segment in the restaurant industry," Collier said.
-- However, based on the projected fourth quarter results and a more conservative earnings scenario going forward, Rauscher Pierce reduced its 1997 earnings estimate.
-- The drop in the rating by one level to buy-market outperformer reflects what Collier called the "higher-risk/higher-return profile" of the company.
-- New York Bagel operates 33 bagel restaurants as of year-end 1996.
